case: caption phrase grouping, holds, SRT/VTT escaping, non-speech, retiming with the cut
targets: lib/captions.mjs buildCues / addNonSpeech / srtText / vttText / retime / syncCheck / burnInDecision / writeSidecars

checks.name: phrase grouping
checks.setup: words with a 0.9 s pause and a sentence end
checks.expect: cue breaks at the pause and the sentence end; lines balanced; units counted in graphemes

checks.name: no English reading-speed law
checks.expect: policy.reading_rate_cps null, source configured_default, needs_validation true; hold is speech span plus padding, never a chars-per-second formula unless the owner configured one

checks.name: configured rate
checks.expect: holds lengthen to fit the configured rate and syncCheck warns above it; the value is recorded as configured

checks.name: SRT escaping
checks.setup: cue text 'a --> b', 'x & y', a blank line inside
checks.expect: no blank line inside a cue; arrow replaced; < escaped; timestamps use comma, ms never 1000

checks.name: VTT escaping
checks.expect: WEBVTT header, dot timestamps, & < > escaped, cue identifiers have no spaces or arrows

checks.name: non-speech
checks.setup: cues.json cue with caption_text 'door slams'; another meaningful without text
checks.expect: [door slams] added and trimmed before the next speech cue; the other is listed unlabelled and not guessed

checks.name: variant cut
checks.setup: retime with entries from a 30 s to 18 s cut
checks.expect: cues move with the edit; cues in the removed span are dropped and reported; syncCheck flags any cue past the new duration

checks.name: overlap and gaps
checks.expect: syncCheck reports overlapping speech cues and a cue after the film ends

checks.name: burn-in
checks.expect: no burn-in when the footage already shows captions (sidecar still written); burn-in follows the profile when required; otherwise optional

checks.name: atomic sidecars
checks.expect: writeSidecars writes srt and vtt via atomicWrite; a failure leaves no half file
